core.stage: ProjectTrustV1 records and pre-dispatch digest checks
core.detail: canonicalRootIdentity binds realpath + dev/ino; approvedFileDigests resolves every approved path through canonical()/inside() so links, retargets and escapes are rejected; verifyProjectTrust recomputes identity and every digest before dispatch; ProjectTrustLedger revisions, revocation and audit retention verified.

core.stage: SecretRefV1 custody, approval-gated resolution, child env allowlist, structured redaction
core.detail: Opaque refs carry only id/purpose/owner/destination; resolution requires a single-use, expiring, exact-destination approval inside the ledger; revocation blocks one ref without touching others; buildChildEnvironment starts from an explicit allowlist; createSecretRedactor covers raw/JSON-escaped/percent/base64/ANSI-split/multiline known values plus declared fields and never claims universal redaction.

core.stage: ExecutionProfileV1 decision contract and backend selection
core.detail: evaluateExecution enforces the three host flags, TRUSTED_HOST explicit-only, trust validity, scope coverage, cwd containment, exact executable digest + argv allowlist match, single approved backend selection, and PASS platformProofRef matching. Shell text is always one effectful command. Missing/ambiguous backend, missing proof and disabled sub-capabilities all fail closed with no unrestricted fallback.

screenPackage distinguishes KNOWN_BAD, NO_KNOWN_MATCH, UNAVAILABLE and stale-cache recheck by exact package/version/digest; clean lookup is recorded as non-authorizing; operator exceptions are recorded separately and cannot override KNOWN_BAD; screeningGate can only BLOCK, stay NEUTRAL or record an exception.

Exactly security.projectTrustV1, security.secretRefsV1, security.executionProfilesV1 registered, all default false, env channel HARNESS_FLAG_* accepts only 1/true, and strict UI preferences reject the keys.

integration.detail: installPluginPackage gained an optional screening hook: when security.executionProfilesV1 is enabled it requires a composed AdvisoryDatabase and enforces screeningGate (KNOWN_BAD/UNAVAILABLE-without-exception deny; exception proceeds as OPERATOR_EXCEPTION). Flag off and no advisory composed leaves the legacy path byte-identical; plugin-host and plugin-workspace-navigation suites pass 70/70.

Every host process launch inventoried: capabilities/process.ts processEnvironment() is already an explicit allowlist (PATH/SystemRoot/TEMP/HOME/APPDATA family plus git safety vars, never process.env); workspace terminal uses that allowlist plus caller-pinned environment; runProcess callers are fixed-argv host tooling (git, node --test). No launch site copies raw process.env.

No product surface executes project-controlled untrusted code today; evaluateExecution is the decision contract a future confined consumer must call. Agent CLIs, the user terminal and host tooling are trusted fixed-argv launches outside this boundary. With flags off (default) behavior is unchanged; with flags on and no approved backend/proof, executable stages stay disabled by construction.

createSecretRedactor is implemented and tested for the declared scope. SecretRef values cannot enter journals or model context by construction (they exist only inside resolve() results), so no sink currently emits them; wiring the redactor into future secret-bearing output paths remains open.

platform.stage: Windows native negative matrix (outside-root rw, protected state, DNS/TCP, child escape, registry, junction swap, second user, kill cleanup)
platform.detail: Requires the actual packaged launcher under its real token plus an installed, independently approved backend with a PASS platform proof. No such backend exists on this host; source inspection cannot certify one. Executable stages remain disabled.
No non-Windows proof was attempted; per contract these stay BLOCKED rather than silently passing.

migration.detail: No data migration. New flags default false; legacy credential stores, plugin inventory and terminal behavior are unchanged. ProjectTrustLedger persists only when constructed with a Store; no existing records were rewritten.

rollback: Unset the three HARNESS_FLAG_SECURITY_* environment variables (all default false) to disable every new capability. installPluginPackage returns to the legacy path when security.executionProfilesV1 is off and no screening advisory is composed. No execution profiles exist to revoke; if any are later issued, rollback revokes profiles, stops owned children, retains account stores and historical trust/audit records, and restores legacy credential reads only after verified compatibility. No existing policy was loosened to recover availability.
